thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error and queue backlog for /v1/embeddings in us-east-1. Pager P1 routed to oncall (Maya). Detected at 23:05 UTC. Automatic retry/backoff attempts increasing.

Maya (Oncall): ack. joining war room. dropping link in a sec.

Maya (Oncall): war room -> https://meet.redwood.com/warroom/3265432100 (pin: emb-us-3265)

Deploy Bot: recent routing tweak deployed 22:50 UTC (id: route-20260315-22) 1: added pooled-queue opt for batching, changed prefetch from 2 -> 8.

Ravi (SRE): seeing long queue depth on pool-emb-07 and rising 500s from emb-worker hosts. Logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T23:03:47Z emb-worker-07 queue_wait 14.2s /v1/embeddings 500 "queue timeout"
2026-03-15T23:04:12Z emb-worker-12 process 500 "OOM during reduction"
```
No core DB errors. Might be memory pressure from larger prefetch.

Leo (Eng): that routing tweak could have increased simultaneous batch creation. Quick mitigation options: 1) reduce prefetch back to 2; 2) drain high-latency workers from LB; 3) enable fallback to lower-memory quantized embedding model; 4) increase autoscaler headroom for short term. I'd push for 1 & 2 immediately.

Maya (Oncall): executing 1 & 2. Running commands now:
```
configctl set routing.prefetch 2 --env us-east-1 --reason "mitigate embedding queue backlog"
infractl drain --host emb-worker-07 --reason "high queue"
infractl drain --host emb-worker-12 --reason "OOM observed"
```

Oncall Pager: Maya acknowledged at 23:07 UTC. Drain jobs enqueued.

Nora (Support): prepping status page and customer email. Draft status page blurb: "We are investigating an elevated error rate and increased latency for the Embeddings API in us-east-1. Engineers are mitigating by isolating affected hosts and rolling back a recent routing prefetch change. We will provide updates every 15 minutes." Add impact: some batch embedding jobs may fail.

Maya (Oncall): also rolling fallback routing for short sequences/batches to quantized-embed-v1:
```
routing set-fallback --route /v1/embeddings --condition "batch_size<32 and seq_len<1024" --model quantized-embed-v1 --weight 0.4
```

Ravi (SRE): enabling fallback. Observing immediate drop in queue length from 12 -> 4 on pool-emb-07. Error rate falling from ~18% -> ~5%.

Leo (Eng): recommend increasing autoscaler target temporarily to avoid new hosts being overloaded while drained hosts reprovision. Command:
```
autoscaler set --pool pool-emb-07 --min 6 --max 20 --reason "mitigate P1 backlog"
```

Maya (Oncall): applied autoscaler change. Monitoring memory and tail latencies.

Nora (Support): customer email draft: "We're investigating elevated errors and latency in the Embeddings API (us-east-1). Our engineers have isolated affected hosts and are routing traffic to fallback model variants to stabilize service. If your jobs are failing, please retry with exponential backoff and reduce batch sizes where possible. We will follow up with an incident summary after mitigation." Include link to status page. Shall I send to affected accounts now?

Billing Bot: Note for SLA: track total minutes of degraded service per account and whether they exceed per-tenant outage thresholds. Tagging billing-team.

Maya (Oncall): yes please send targeted email to accounts with >5% failure rate in the last 30m. Nora, can you coordinate?

Nora (Support): will send targeted emails (bcc) and post a status update. Also add a line advising Dedicated customers to DM support if they need immediate throughput guarantees.

Deploy Bot: no model or code deploys in last hour besides routing.prefetch change.

Ravi (SRE): quick log excerpt for visibility (sanitized):
```
2026-03-15T23:05:10Z emb-worker-07 runtime: reduction step memory spike 9.8GB -> allocation failed
2026-03-15T23:06:20Z router-03 accept request from 172.31.8.9 route /v1/embeddings queued 11.4s
```

Leo (Eng): looks like prefetch led to more concurrent batch formation driving memory OOMs on reduction. Action: add canary and gating for similar prefetch increases and add an alert for queue depth > 8 per pool.

Maya (Oncall): creating internal comms for ops-channel now: 
"Summary: Embeddings API degradation in us-east-1 due to routing prefetch increase causing queue backlog and memory pressure. Mitigations: rolled routing prefetch back, drained affected workers, enabled quantized fallback, increased autoscaler headroom. Impact: transient failures for some batch jobs. Owner: Maya (oncall). Postmortem owner: Leo. Next update: in 15 minutes."

Status Page Bot: publishing initial update at 23:10 UTC.

Nora (Support): sending targeted emails now. Bcc list includes affected accounts; generic status page link included.

Maya (Oncall): setting close criteria: error rate <1% and queue depth <3 for 10 continuous minutes. Currently error rate 3.2%, queue depth avg 2.1. Continuing monitor.

Leo (Eng): grabbing sanitized traces and kernel logs to attach to RCA. I'll own postmortem and propose concrete fixes: add pre-deploy canary for routing prefetch changes, per-pool queue depth alerts, and memory headroom policy.

Ravi (SRE): will file follow-up infra ticket to add queue-depth alert and adjust autoscaler policies to prefer gradual ramp for pooling changes. Assign to infra-ops.

Maya (Oncall): handoff plan: if stable at 23:30, I'll handoff to Ravi for overnight watch. Handoff includes runbook snippet, commands used, and customer comms.

Billing Bot: Billing team will compute potential SLA credit exposure if degradation lasts > 30 minutes for any paid entitled account; please tag them in the incident doc.

Nora (Support): posting a 15-min update to status page: "Mitigations applied; error rate decreasing. Targeted emails sent to affected customers. Engineers continuing to monitor." Posted at 23:20 UTC.

Ravi (SRE): observed metrics: error rate stable at 0.6% for 7 minutes, queue depth avg 1.8. Good sign. Preparing handoff notes.

Maya (Oncall): handing off to Ravi at 23:32 UTC. Handoff checklist: prefetch reverted, emb-worker-07/12 drained and reprovisioning, fallback weight 0.4 active for small batches, autoscaler set min6/max20, Billing tagged for SLA. Postmortem owner: Leo.

Ravi (SRE): taking handoff. I'll keep war room pinned for 20 minutes then close if no regressions. Creating internal comms template for #ops: 
"Incident: Embeddings API us-east-1 degradation. Mitigations performed; targeted customer notifications sent. Owners: Maya (mitigation), Leo (RCA), Ravi (follow-up). Action items: add canary for prefetch changes, queue-depth alerts, autoscaler policy tweaks."

Nora (Support): scheduled final customer follow-up at 00:15 UTC with timeline and contact info.

Status Page Bot: final update queued once criteria met.

Incident Bot: reminder: if incident duration > 1 hour escalate to incident commander and file SEV>1 process.

Ravi (SRE): metrics stable for 12 minutes now. Closing pager when criteria met (error <1% and queue <3 for 10m). Leaving internal note and will open postmortem ticket assigned to Leo with due date EOD.

Nora (Support): locking thread for follow-ups; will reopen if regression. :lock:
